description: Get the browser link to subscribe to a plan. The on-chain subscription is signed by the subscriber wallet in the browser — this tool moves no funds and does not subscribe by itself, so never report it as completed. Open authorizeUrl, then verify with actora_subscription_my_list.

chain.description: Chain: "bsc" (default) | "ethereum" | "base". Sepolia testnet is not supported.

name: actora_subscription_subscribe
title: Subscribe to Plan
